revision.refused: No edits committed. The proposed smallest-stored-y priority explains this round's choice but is not established as a general selection convention across trajectories; the smallest-x tie-breaker has no reported support. Applying it after reveal, after placement, and in fallbacks would repeat the unsupported spatial and color priorities rejected in earlier rounds. Both the selected and recorded cubes were eligible, and all memory updates were correct, so neither memory document needs changing. Retain the any-eligible-target rule. Exact recorded-target prediction remains unresolved and requires an independently specified convention or evidence establishing a general priority, rather than another rule inferred from a single ambiguous choice.
